automaticBakeEvidence.note: Archived product bake assets are provenance, not physical mesh input or proof of live bindings; explicit reports are reported without an invented binding claim.

referenceAdapter.limitation: Conditional on the declared source, signal and qualified independent reference evidence. Hashes establish byte correspondence, not physical validity or source-export completeness. Missing pixels never pass. No Unity/DXR execution, dynamic stability, performance or production acceptance is inferred.

limits: EXR magic only; RGBA32F is the numeric evidence. Host/editor restoration is a receipt check, not an independent workspace restoration audit. No image/reference/threshold/performance verdict.
